convoLines.text: "Are you going to stay? With us. For real."
Something eases in their shoulders. "Good. We're better with you here. I mean that."
"This one — Mugwort. Leaf, stem, smell. You won't forget it now."
"Still on whether you're staying. Makes sense to me."
"Okay. Yeah. I trust you."
"Come get air with me. I need to think out loud."
You walk to the ridge with Liam. Nothing much there — but they talk the whole way, and you learn the shape of them a little better.
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
"You want to know about that? Okay." Every meal is a small victory. I'm collecting victories.
"Watch people eat. The ones who share without thinking — those are your people."
"Anyway — I should get back to it. Good talking, though."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"This was good." They mean it.
"Do you dream about before? Or is it all — this — now?"
"Okay." Something shutters, just slightly.
"...What's that supposed to mean?" Their voice goes careful.
"Still on what you dream about."
"Okay. Yeah. I trust you."
"Forget I said anything. What did you want? Just... be straight with me."
"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:
They go very still. Not relaxed-still. Held-still.
"Oh." A long pause. "I don't actually want to belong somewhere. I want to be remembered. The truth felt small. The lie felt like someone worth keeping around." Nikos won't meet your eyes.
🤝 "The Company." It hangs in the air a moment — then Liam grins. It's real now. It has a name, which means it can be lost.
"That again?" Nikos sighs. "I confessed that already. I'm not confessing it twice for dramatic effect."
"You're a good listener, you know that?" A tired smile.
"I should go. You know where to find me."
"Well. Can I tell you something? I stole medicine from the stash once and never confessed."
Caroline seems lighter — something good landed recently.
"So." They look at the fire for a moment.
"Still on what they confided."
"Okay. Yeah. I trust you."
You show them Pawpaw — where it grows, how to tell it apart. Their eyes widen. "I never knew that."
"Don't tell anyone I told you. What's on your mind? It'll keep."
"Huh. Let me think about that." "Jacob is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
"I sit apart to eat. It doesn't bring anyone back. It just keeps my hands from shaking."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
🤝 Caroline is 👁️ Scout now. Sees trouble first. Warns the party on the road.
"Well. My social battery is officially dead."
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the east treeline."
"The stores won't stretch past tomorrow, and I'm not choosing who eats. Nobody's worked the east treeline in days. We'll fill packs before dark."
Move next to your partner, on the same side of the Haven door.
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
"You want to know about that? Okay." "Since Jacob died... I keep expecting to see Jacob at the fire. Stupid."
"Sleep's gone strange. I save the best bite for last at odd hours now. Whatever gets me to morning."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
Caroline nods, stepping back. "Scout is yours now." (Roles are promises. There's only one of each.)
"The fire feels smaller without Jacob. The rest of us will have to be bigger."
"Still on what's been happening."
You show them Pawpaw — where it grows, how to tell it apart. A short laugh. "And I've been walking past it for weeks."
"Alright — I should get back to it."
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"...Think about it? I'll be around."
"This was good." They mean it.
"My wound needs a second pair of hands. Will you help me clean it?"
"It's getting worse, not better. If it festers I'm no good to anyone — can't haul, can't hunt, can't watch. Just clean it out and wrap it tight."
Move next to them, on the same side of the Haven door, to help.
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
Their eyes do the math before their mouth does. You can see the calculation happening.
A pause that's a beat too long. "I think you're confused," Tariq says, not quite looking at you.
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
They hear the warmth in it. They're not ready to let it in.
"No, yeah, of course. Forget I asked." They won't forget. They'll just stop asking.
"Still on that wound care."
"Right. Go on, then."
"Forget I asked. I'll figure it out."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"Pawpaw — I keep thinking about what you said. I'm seeing it everywhere now."
Caroline has an edge today — something curdled.
They nod slowly, not quite done, not quite continuing.
"Still on that plant lesson."
They hear the warmth in it. They're not ready to let it in.
"Yeah? What's up?"
"Good question." "Last time things were different. They always are." "The Auction. They just... took Boris and Nikos. Came back like nothing happened. It wasn't nothing."
"I show up. That's my part."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
Nikos nods, stepping back. "Scout is yours now." (Roles are promises. There's only one of each.)
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"This was good." They mean it.
Do something worth retelling. That's the whole plan.
"Fame is just being remembered by strangers. I'll take it."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
Caroline nods, stepping back. "Scout is yours now." (Roles are promises. There's only one of each.)
"Anyway." A small smile.
"Still on wanting to be remembered."
A pause. When they speak again, it's about something else entirely.
"Anyway — that's my cross to carry. What's on your mind?"
"You want to know about that? Okay." "Huh. I answered that once — back when the answer was simpler." "You saw it too, right? The Auction. Tell me I didn't imagine the lights."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Right. Go on, then."
"...Think about it? I'll be around."
"This was good." They mean it.
"Can we talk?" Nikos sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Walk with me? I want another pair of eyes on something."
"Here. I made an extra." Nikos presses something into your hand — a decent tool, oiled and kept. (Useful. Keep it.)
"Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Will you forage with me tomorrow? Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground."
"I did the count twice. The count doesn't change. Meet me at the east treeline and we'll fill packs before dark."
As I said — Move next to your partner, on the same side of the Haven door.
"Forget I said anything. What did you want?"
"You want to know about that? Okay." "You asked me that before. It's a different question now." "They took you — The Alibi Chain, on the screens. The whole fire watched. Nobody knew where to look."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
🤝 Nikos is 👁️ Scout now. Sees trouble first. Warns the party on the road.
"Well." A breath. "That's where things stand."
"Like I said — Still on what's been happening."
You show them Brazil Nuts — where it grows, how to tell it apart. "Huh." They turn it over in their mind. "I'll remember that one."
"Rest when you can. We'll talk again soon."
"...Think about it? I'll be around."
"It's been a while. Glad we circled back to what's been happening."
"This was good." They mean it.
"When's the last time you really laughed?"
"Okay." Something shutters, just slightly.
"Still on the last time you laughed."
"Okay. Yeah. I trust you."
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up? Good talking."
"You want to know about that? Okay." "The Alibi Chain. They just... took you. Came back like nothing happened. It wasn't nothing."
"I oil boots on rest days. It passes the time. The time passes anyway."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."
Nikos nods, stepping back. "Scout is yours now." (Roles are promises. There's only one of each.)
They nod slowly, not quite done, not quite continuing.
You show them Pawpaw — where it grows, how to tell it apart. They nod slowly, committing it to memory. "Good to know. Really good to know."
"And... scene. Good talk."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
